description: This file defines the 'Log' utility class which provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper and replacement for Android's native Log, allowing chaining of LogNodes for custom logging behaviors.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging at multiple levels, managing LogNode chain, and facilitating log message routing.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode for the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log messages to the current LogNode, with support for optional Throwable parameter.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with optional Throwable.
